title: FileSchema

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: Deprecated: Use `folder_id` field instead. The unique identifier of the source associated with the document.

original_file_name.title: Original File Name
original_file_name.description: The original name of the file as uploaded.

file_type.title: File Type
file_type.description: The type of the file (MIME type).

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_creation_date.title: File Creation Date
file_creation_date.description: The creation date of the file.

file_last_modified_date.title: File Last Modified Date
file_last_modified_date.description: The last modified date of the file.

processing_status.description: The current processing status of the file (e.g. pending, parsing, embedding, completed, error).

error_message.title: Error Message
error_message.description: Optional error message if the file failed processing.

total_chunks.title: Total Chunks
total_chunks.description: Total number of chunks for the file.

chunks_embedded.title: Chunks Embedded
chunks_embedded.description: Number of chunks that have been embedded.

content.title: Content
content.description: Optional full-text content of the file; only populated on demand due to its size.

id.title: Id
id.description: Human-readable identifier for this file in the file
